description: Quality verification harness for temporal_stability_enrichment.py. Loads the enricher module, calls compute_score() against a synthetic corpus of 20+ metadata dicts with varied age_days, first_seen, last_updated, last_verdict fields. Asserts that output scores produce at least 10 distinct values (signal quality floor per spec). Logs score distribution to LOG_PATH. Does NOT modify the enricher itself. Reads temporal_stability_enrichment.py directly. This is a diagnostic tool, not a rebuild. Referenced spec section 3 (signal invariant) and the weak signal diagnostic showing 4 distinct values.
